The article title, DOI, authors, article-specific CC BY 4.0 notice, Table 2 Actual Density cells and sections 2.1-2.3 were cross-checked. rights.changes: Changes: selected nominal formulation, state and measured density facts transcribed into structured candidate records with explicit unknowns and source qualifications. No author or publisher endorsement is implied.

composition_qualification: Nominal source-qualified reinforcement loading in Mg-3Al-1Zn (AZ31) matrix powder, not an analyzed final composition, certified purity or exact phase fraction. Starting-powder purity and nominal matrix designation do not establish the purity or composition of the finished composite.
density_scope: Only Table 2 Actual Density for the two as-extruded nano-Ti/Mg-3Al-1Zn composites is selected. Theoretical density, tensile data and the unreinforced 0 wt% Ti comparator are excluded. Density temperature, pressure, humidity, specimen count, repetitions, aggregation, uncertainty, density basis and porosity are unknown. The three tensile specimens and room temperature in section 2.3 do not qualify density in section 2.2. No tensile-specimen dimensions, zero porosity, mean or zero uncertainty is inferred.
source_discrepancies: Table 2 prints the second selected row as 1 wt Ti, omitting the percent symbol. The literal designation is preserved. Sections 2.1 and 2.2 separately specify the nominal 1 wt% nano-Ti loading; the table text is not silently corrected and final composition is not inferred.
exclusions: Theoretical density column and all derived density/porosity calculations.
The unreinforced 0 wt% Ti comparator; no new AZ31 identity or property is proposed.
All tensile properties, tensile specimen counts and tensile test conditions.
Analyzed final composition, certified purity, exact final reinforcement fraction and unreported density conditions.
Extra identities for processing states, repeated measurements, constituents or bare shared matrix aliases.
separate_source_transcription_review: A separate read-only source audit cleared these two factual selections, article-specific rights and archive-manifest corroboration. Candidate, runtime and publication review remain separate gates.
pending: Independent parent review of the immutable candidate packet before any runtime admission or publication.
